**Claim:** `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S` · branch `claude/issue-8266-dashboard-count-aggregate-datakey`

PM dispatch. Assignee and this claim are set by the PM seat for the dev seat; the dev inherits both and posts no second claim.

## ⛔ MEASUREMENT FIRST — this dispatch may correctly end in "close it, I was wrong"

The card's own confidence statement is binding: **the chain is source-derived, not render-measured.** ⛔ Do not write a fix before reproducing the failure.

**Reproduce first.** Author a dashboard chart widget, `provider: 'object'`, aggregate `{ function: 'count', groupBy: 'status' }`, **no `field`**, and establish what actually renders. If something downstream reconciles `'value'` with `'count'` and the chart plots correctly, **the card is wrong** — say so, post the measurement, and close it. That is a **successful** outcome of this dispatch, not a failure, and it costs the repo far less than a fix for a defect that does not exist.

Only if it reproduces do you proceed to a fix.

## The chain to check (re-derive it, do not trust this)

Two independent copies:

```
plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx:227   const yField = options.yField || 'value';
plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx:239   const effectiveYField = effectiveAggregate?.field || yField;
plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx:246   series: [{ dataKey: effectiveYField }],

plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx:607/:618  the same two lines
```

against

```
plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx:37-38
  aggregateValueKey = aggregate.field || aggregate.function || 'count'
```

⇒ series asks for `'value'`, rows carry `'count'`.

⭐ Two pieces of corroboration already on `main`, both worth confirming yourself:

- `ObjectChart.aggregateResultColumns.test.ts:34` **already pins** `aggregateValueKey({ function: 'count' })` `toBe('count')`. That half needs no new proof — it needs you to check nothing else re-keys the rows after it.
- `DashboardRenderer.tsx:320` reads `const isSynthetic = !yField || yField === 'value' || yField === 'count';` — the **label** path knows about this exact duality. The **dataKey** path does not consult it. If the defect is real, that asymmetry is the shape of it.

## ⚠️ The loose end the card deliberately did not settle — settle it

`DashboardGridLayout.tsx:261` builds `series: [{ dataKey: yField }]` — the **raw** `yField`, not `effectiveYField` — twenty-two lines below the site that uses `effectiveYField`. Whether those are two legitimately different branches or a third spelling of one decision was **not** determined.

⛔ Do not patch `:239`/`:618` and leave `:261` unexamined. Either it is a different branch (say why, in the PR body) or it is the same decision spelled a third time, in which case the fix is one resolver, not two edits — the objectui#5042 / objectui#7544 / objectui#8193 shape this repo has now hit four times.

## If it reproduces: shape of the fix

Prefer **one place that answers "which column carries the measure"**, consulted by both the row projection and the series binding, over patching each site to agree. That is the anti-drift move objectui#8168 just made in `ObjectChart` (`resolveChartCategoryField` replacing three spellings at three fidelities) and it is the same problem one axis over.

⛔ Do not "fix" it by making `aggregateValueKey` return `'value'` for a fieldless count — that would contradict an existing pin and rename the column every other consumer reads.

## Bar

- Prove any new pin CAN fail: ablate it, show the assertion red BY NAME, restore BY STATE (`git diff HEAD` empty AND `git hash-object` == `git rev-parse HEAD:PATH`), never by an exit code.
- Zero-hit greps need a control that fires; prefer `grep -cF` and print the matched lines.
- ⚠️ `pnpm --filter PKG exec vitest run FILE` is refused by an explicit guard here (objectui#3378) — it re-roots vitest at the package dir and reports a pass count having run **none** of the target files. Silent false green. Run from the repo root.
- Clause ②: a change to which column a chart reads moves what renders. State it, do not assume it.

## Dedup owed

The card carries **no** dedup claim — the search channel was rate-limited when it was written, and an uncontrolled zero carries no information. **Run the dedup yourself with a control that fires**, before writing code. Suggested query: `dashboard chart count aggregate no field empty plot dataKey value`. If you find prior art, that changes this dispatch — report it.

⛔ Draft PR only — the PM flips and lands. Never `git stash`. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`. Worktree-first. Return the standard structured JSON report, and say bluntly if anything above is wrong — it is a reconstruction, and this session has had four corrected by devs, three of which would have caused damage if followed. Blunt corrections are wanted.
